sections.label: What is Ocula360
sections.heading: One Retinal Image. Layered Diagnostic Intelligence.
paragraphs: Ocula360 is our foundational AI engine—designed to detect multiple retinal diseases from a single image. Built on a foundational model architecture, it delivers explainable lesion-level outputs, advanced DRSS scoring, and multimodal compatibility that scales from individual clinic workflows to enterprise screening programs.

From diabetic retinopathy to age-related macular degeneration to glaucoma indicators, Ocula360 transforms one scan into a comprehensive diagnostic signal—so providers can act earlier, researchers can move faster, and patients get the care they need, sooner.
sections.closing: At its core, Ocula360 is not a feature set. It is a platform.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.heading: Built for the Full Diagnostic Stack

items.title: Multi-Disease Detection
items.body: Detects diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration (AMD), glaucoma indicators, vascular abnormalities, hemorrhages, microaneurysms, and exudates—all from a single image.

items.title: Automated DRSS Scoring
items.body: Standardized severity grading for diabetic retinopathy, supporting consistent disease staging and eligibility decisions across screening programs.

items.title: Lesion-Level Explainability
items.body: Transparent confidence outputs and lesion overlays show clinicians exactly where and why the model flagged a finding—building trust, not black boxes.

items.title: Multimodal & Future-Ready
items.body: Compatible with fundus imaging, ultra-widefield (UWF) scans, and patient metadata. Architected to integrate additional inputs as imaging standards evolve.

sections.label: How it works
sections.heading: Simple. Scalable. Integrated.
sections.intro: Ocula360 fits seamlessly into any retinal imaging workflow.

items.title: Capture
items.body: Any retinal image from any supported camera—fundus, handheld, or ultra-widefield.

items.title: Upload
items.body: Images upload to the Ocula360 platform via secure, HIPAA-compliant transfer.

items.title: Analyze
items.body: The foundational model processes the image, detecting findings and grading severity based on your configured study criteria.

items.title: Act
items.body: Receive explainable reports with lesion-level overlays and confidence signals—ready for clinical review, referral routing, or trial enrollment decisions.

sections.label: Use cases
sections.heading: Built for How You Work
sections.intro: Ocula360 powers deployments across screening, clinical care, and research—adapting to the workflow, not the other way around.

items.title: Population Screening
items.body: Deploy Ocula360 in primary care networks, community health centers, and home health programs to identify at-risk patients at scale—before vision loss occurs.
items.tag: Often delivered via Nsight360 or Ophthal360

items.title: Diagnostic Support
items.body: Give optometrists and eye care professionals a second layer of AI-assisted insight on complex or borderline cases—reducing variability and increasing confidence.

items.title: Clinical Research
items.body: Accelerate patient identification for retinal-based clinical trials. Ocula360 analyzes ultra-widefield imaging against study-specific criteria, reducing manual review burden and shortening enrollment timelines.
items.tag: Ocula360 direct deployment for pharma / CROs

sections.label: Our approach (Human + AI)
sections.heading: Technology that amplifies clinical expertise.
paragraphs: Ocula360 is not designed to replace clinicians. It is built to support them.
By combining AI-driven analysis with expert review, Ocula360 delivers the speed and scale of machine learning with the judgment and trust that only human expertise can provide.

points.body: Every output is explainable, auditable, and grounded in clinical evidence.
Lesion overlays and confidence signals show exactly what the model saw and how it decided.
Clinicians remain in the loop. Ocula360 informs decisions—it does not make them.
